summary: Implemented the Server Route Dispatch Refactor (WP-005 AC-1 through AC-6). Added BodyRoute interface (exported) with typed fields: method, path (string | RegExp), statusCode (optional), noBody (optional), handler. Added buildBodyRoutes() factory function that captures closure variables (ledgerRoot, configPath, orchestratorLogsDir, bootVersions) via arrow functions and returns a BodyRoute[] table of all 19 inline route blocks previously in handleRequest(). Added dispatchBodyRoute() function that iterates the table, matches by method + path (string equality or RegExp exec), conditionally calls readJsonBody() (skips when noBody:true), invokes the handler, writes the response (204 case: empty body/no sendJson; default: sendJson with statusCode ?? 200), and handles the full error chain (PayloadTooLargeError → 413, ApiError → apiErrorToStatus, generic → 500). Refactored handleRequest() from ~448 lines to 55 lines: OPTIONS preflight → static serving → dispatchBodyRoute → matchRoute fallback → 404. All RegExp paths use named capture groups (?<name>…). Deprecated routes (PATCH /api/projects/:slug, POST /api/projects/:slug/reset) preserved in route table. Post-refactor: TypeScript type-check passes (0 errors), all 3593 tests pass across 118 test files.

comments.note: buildBodyRoutes() is called on every request, creating a fresh BodyRoute[] array each time. This is a micro-optimization — at the current request volume it has no measurable impact, but worth noting for completeness.
